Claim amendment · 2026-11-15T04:48Z · to claim 6889348795. `File surface:` now also takes two new files: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/services/lazyPage.tsx` and `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/studio-object-records-canvas.tsx`.

Reason (dev's read on `3c0033f9`): three sites need #33580's `lazyPage` (`builtinComponents.tsx` for the position cells, `datasource/register.ts`, `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` for the default canvas). The existing wrapper moves out of `builtinComponents.tsx` into `lazyPage.tsx` unchanged, plus an optional fallback argument so a table cell does not draw the page-sized loading box; there stays exactly one wrapper. Importing `builtinComponents.tsx` from the other two would drag its side-effect registrations into every test that imports the canvas registry. The default canvas moves to `studio-object-records-canvas.tsx`; `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` keeps the `StudioObjectRecordsCanvas` export name as the lazily registered value, so `StudioDesignSurface`'s identity check needs no edit. No overlap with ui seat 1's live PRs (#33485 #33493 #33575 #33585) or its #33581 fence. Nothing else in the claim changes.
